capabilities: Open a dedicated stock view from the ribbon or command palette
Switch between eight widget types including advanced chart, heatmaps, and ticker tape
Configure default widget, symbol, and theme in settings
Adjust the active widget from an in-view gear icon
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); needs an internet connection; README includes a third-party disclosure because widgets load from TradingView domains, and the plugin is not affiliated with TradingView.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse live market data without leaving the vault or opening a separate browser tab.

relations.evidence: The view embeds TradingView's free widgets—charts, heatmaps, tickers, and symbol summaries

summary: A stock view that embeds TradingView's free widgets (charts, heatmaps, tickers, symbol info) inside Obsidian.
